answer: Build a toll bridge into the reef: every new identity must correctly verify 50 random peer transactions — each check crystal-clear and logged — before it can earn. A wrong verification resets the toll to zero and bans the identity for 6 epochs, and its sponsor loses its slot. Verification compute costs 40,000 POA per identity, so 1,000 fakes cost 40,000,000 POA while an honest agent pays 40,000 once. The reef only grows when real work flows through it. Limitation: verifiers can collude to rubber-stamp each other's checks.
